from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker: full line of a single non-bg color
    mline=None; mori=None; mcol=None
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: mline=i; mori='h'
    for j in range(w):
        colset={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(colset)==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: mline=j; mori='v'
    mc=g[mline][0] if mori=='h' else g[0][mline]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,mc)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # remove shape
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    FILL=8
    if mori=='v':
        # slide shape horizontally until adjacent to marker column
        if mline < c0: shift=-(c0-mline-1); nearline=c0-1
        elif mline > c1: shift=(mline-c1-1); nearline=c1+1
        else: shift=0; nearline=None
        if nearline is None or nearline==mline:
            far = c1+1 if mline<c0 else c0-1
        else:
            far = c1+1 if mline<c0 else c0-1 if False else None
        # far side opposite marker
        if shift!=0 or True:
            far = (max(cs)+shift)+1 if mline<c0 else (min(cs)+shift)-1
            if far==mline: far = (max(cs)+shift)-1 if mline<c0 else (min(cs)+shift)+1
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j+shift]=g[i][j]
        for i in range(h): out[i][far]=FILL
    else:
        if mline < r0: shift=-(r0-mline-1)
        elif mline > r1: shift=(mline-r1-1)
        else: shift=0
        far = (max(rs)+shift)+1 if mline<r0 else (min(rs)+shift)-1
        if far==mline: far = (max(rs)+shift)-1 if mline<r0 else (min(rs)+shift)+1
        for i,j in cells: out[i+shift][j]=g[i][j]
        for j in range(w): out[far][j]=FILL
    return out
